title: Chicken Nuggets
body:
# Chicken Nuggets

## About

This is a Minecraft mod that adds chicken nuggets. Chicken nuggets are great because they combine bread and chicken.

## Tip

Craft chicken nuggets by putting one cooked chicken and one bread in a crafting table.

## Sources

This mod can be found on these websites:
- [GitHub](https://github.com/thecoolguy62aws/chickenNuggets)
- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/chicken-nugget)
